# Story 15 — Enhance Feedback, status and page-state components (Story: 15)

## Prerequisites

- Stories 9–14 in `.squad/stories/some-enhancment/` (design-system enhancement stream) have delivered the shared component library layer that this story extends. This plan only edits files under `frontend/src/shared/components/**` and their consumers in `frontend/src/features/**`, and touches one small area on the backend (seed data) to normalise the seeded role name at its source.
- No new backend API is required; correlation IDs are already surfaced by `frontend/src/shared/api/httpClient.ts` (`correlationId` on `ApiError`, `frontend/src/shared/api/ApiError.ts` lines 11, 20, 25, 30).
- Coordinate with the theme owners: this story adds new semantic tokens for status colour + focus ring outside the components themselves in `frontend/src/shared/theme/tokens.ts` and `frontend/src/shared/theme/cssVariables.ts` (design-token G1).

---

## Story Goal

Turn the feedback / status / page-state rules from DD-04, DD-08 and DD-10 into a **single, tokenised set of components** that every screen uses instead of ad-hoc markup.

Concrete user-visible outcomes:

1. **Toasts** are polite, dismissible, pause on hover/focus, do not auto-dismiss anything that requires a decision, and stack without covering the primary action.
2. **Inline banners** (`Alert`) carry retry actions and a correlation ID for recoverable errors, and offer an assertive variant for validation summaries.
3. **Confirmation dialogs** state the real consequence (name of the record, count of dependants), and irreversible ones require a typed confirmation.
4. **Status badges** always render dot + label + accessible text, never colour alone.
5. **Chips** are neutral by default; a semantic tint is only applied where the colour maps to a documented state.
6. **Page states** (`EmptyState`, `FilteredEmpty`, `ErrorState`, `LoadingState`, `NotFound`, `AccessDenied`) share one component surface; every list/detail screen uses them.
7. **Skeletons** match the shape of the content and never flicker (min 300 ms shown).
8. All strings come from `frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/common.json` and `ar/common.json`; all components render correctly in RTL, honour `prefers-reduced-motion`, and pass axe on their design-system doc page.
9. The **seeded role name** is normalised at its source in `backend/app/modules/identity_access/infrastructure/seed.py` so that the chip need not text-transform to hide a data inconsistency.

**Out of scope:** notification centre / persistent history, in-product announcement banners, onboarding tooltips or product tours.

## Product rules (from story)

| Message class | Current behaviour | New behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transient success | Any toast auto-dismisses after 4 s (`DEFAULT_DURATION`, `ToastProvider.tsx` line 25). | Toast — 4 s, polite, dismissible, **pauses on hover/focus**. |
| Success needing next step | Uses a toast. | Inline `Alert variant="success"` with a link/action, stays until dismissed. |
| Recoverable error | Alert without retry / correlation id (`Alert.tsx` today has no `actions` or `correlationId`). | `Alert variant="danger"` with **Retry** and **Correlation ID: xxxx** displayed. |
| Validation summary | Ad-hoc. | `Alert variant="danger" assertive` at the top of the form, `role="alert"`. |
| Blocking decision | Ad-hoc. | `Modal`. |
| Irreversible action | `ConfirmDialog` with generic wording. | `ConfirmDialog destructive consequence={<real data>} confirmationPhrase="<name>"` requiring typed confirmation. |
| Background progress | Sometimes a blocking spinner. | Inline `LoadingState` (or new `ProgressInline`) with label. |
| Status chip | Uses colour alone in some places. | `Status` with dot + label always; colour derived from documented state map. |
| Role chip | `Badge variant="info"` (see `UserListPage.tsx:115`). | Neutral by default (`Badge` with no variant), unless colour maps to a rule. |

### 1 — Toast: dismissible, pauseable, spec-compliant

**File:** `frontend/src/shared/components/feedback/Toast.tsx`

Extend `ToastProps`:

```ts
export type ToastVariant = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';

export interface ToastProps {
  id: number;
  variant: ToastVariant;
  message: string;
  onDismiss: (id: number) => void;
  onPause: (id: number) => void;
  onResume: (id: number) => void;
}
```

- Render a `<div role="status">` (viewport is polite — do not put `role="alert"` here; AC11).
- Add a dismiss button `<button aria-label={t('toast.dismiss')}>×</button>` (G3, G5).
- Wire `onMouseEnter` / `onFocus` inside → `onPause(id)`; `onMouseLeave` / `onBlur` → `onResume(id)`. Use `focus-within`-equivalent handlers (`onFocus`/`onBlur` bubble in React).
- All colours / spacing via `Toast.module.css` tokens; no raw hex (G1).

**File:** `frontend/src/shared/components/feedback/ToastProvider.tsx`

- Replace `setTimeout(() => remove(id), duration)` on **line 40** with a per-toast timer object stored in a `useRef<Map<number, { remaining: number; startedAt: number; timeoutId: number }>>`. Expose `pause(id)` (clears the timeout, subtracts elapsed from `remaining`) and `resume(id)` (`setTimeout(remove, remaining)`).
- `show({ variant = 'info', message, duration = 4000, dismissible = true })`. When `duration === 0`, do not schedule auto-dismissal. **Never** allow `duration === 0` with `variant === 'danger'` (return early and console-warn in dev; the story rule "no auto-dismiss for decisions" is enforced by choosing `Alert`, not a danger toast).
- Viewport keeps `role="status" aria-live="polite"` on line 51. Stack layout uses `position: fixed; inset-block-end: var(--space-lg); inset-inline-end: var(--space-lg);` in `Toast.module.css` (**inset-inline** so RTL flips it automatically — AC12).
- Pass `id`, `onDismiss`, `onPause`, `onResume` to each `Toast`.

### 1 — Normalise role names at their source

**File:** `backend/app/modules/identity_access/infrastructure/seed.py`

- Line 43: keep `ADMIN_ROLE_NAME = "admin"` (already the canonical lower-case form). Add a module-level doc-comment `# Role names are stored lower-case; UI does not text-transform.`

**File (new helper):** `backend/app/modules/identity_access/domain/value_objects/role_name.py`

```python
class RoleName:
    __slots__ = ("value",)

    def __init__(self, raw: str) -> None:
        normalised = raw.strip().lower()
        if not normalised:
            raise ValueError("role name must be non-empty")
        self.value = normalised

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.value
```

**File:** `backend/app/modules/identity_access/application/use_cases/roles/create_role.py`

- At `execute` (line 24), wrap: `name = RoleName(command.name).value` and use `name` in both the duplicate check (line 25) and the `Role(...)` construction (line 28). This makes `find_by_name(command.name)` catch case-only collisions (e.g. `Admin` vs `admin`).

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Toast hover-pause race:** if the user hovers a toast whose timer has already fired the removal callback but React has not yet re-rendered, calling `pause` on a missing entry is a no-op. Guard with `if (!timers.current.has(id)) return;` in `ToastProvider.tsx`.
- **Toast danger + auto-dismiss:** callers can still pass `variant: 'danger'` with a duration; per the intake rule (AC2) the provider must **force** `duration = 0` and log a dev-only warning. Enforced in the `show` callback.
- **Modal focus return** when the trigger element has been unmounted between open and close (e.g. row action button in a virtualised table): fall back to `document.body.focus()` if `previous.isConnected === false`.
- **ConfirmDialog typed confirmation with Unicode / trailing whitespace:** compare against `typed.normalize('NFC').trim() === phrase.normalize('NFC').trim()`. Never re-lowercase; the phrase is case-sensitive so the user commits to reading it.
- **Correlation ID missing:** when the network layer synthesises one (`httpClient.ts` line 146 `crypto.randomUUID()`) the ID is always non-empty; when omitted (offline / cancelled) fall back to `"(no reference)"` — do not crash.
- **LoadingBoundary flicker:** if `loading` is `true` for less than one animation frame, the boundary must **still** hold the fallback for `minDuration`. Test with `vi.useFakeTimers()`.
- **RTL toast entry direction:** the viewport is anchored via `inset-inline-end` so it pins to the writing-mode end. Verify with the RTL test file pattern in `frontend/src/features/authentication/SignInPage.rtl.test.tsx`.
- **Alert with retry and dismiss both set:** ordering is `[Retry] [Dismiss]` in LTR; the flex row is `dir="inherit"` so RTL mirrors it. Do not hard-code `flex-direction: row-reverse`.
- **AccessDenied navigating from a page reached by deep-link:** `onBack` default must be `navigate('/', { replace: true })` — otherwise `history.back()` may exit the app.
- **Existing consumers of `<EmptyState>` with a filtered list:** migrate carefully — an empty list with no filters must still render `<EmptyState>`, not `<FilteredEmpty>`.
- **Role name normalisation collision on `update_role`:** if renaming `Manager` → `manager` collides with existing `manager`, the duplicate check must raise `DuplicateRoleError` (already in `create_role.py` line 26 — mirror in `update_role.py`).

## Migration / Rollback

- No database migration is required. Role-name normalisation is a **write-time** rule; existing rows are unchanged. If a deployed environment already has both `Admin` and `admin`, the next update on either row will raise `DuplicateRoleError` — coordinate a one-off manual rename via SQL before rolling this out to production. Note this in the ops runbook.
- If a regression appears in the toast pause/resume logic, revert `frontend/src/shared/components/feedback/ToastProvider.tsx` to the `setTimeout(remove, duration)` behaviour and disable the pause test — no other component depends on the pause API.
- The `AccessDenied` / `NotFound` migration in `ForbiddenPage.tsx` / `NotFoundPage.tsx` changes the DOM structure of `/forbidden` and the catch-all route. If an e2e test asserts the old `<h1>404</h1>`, update or remove it.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm dev` — visit `/design-system/feedback` (dev only) and page through each component's states.
2. **Frontend unit + integration:** `cd frontend && pnpm test -- --run` (Vitest). Expect all new tests above to pass; existing suites remain green.
3. **Frontend axe:** `cd frontend && pnpm test -- --run FeedbackPage.axe` (subset).
4. **Frontend build & typecheck:** `cd frontend && pnpm build`.
5. **Backend builds:** `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/identity_access/domain/test_role_name_vo.py tests/identity_access/application/test_roles_use_cases.py tests/identity_access/api/test_roles_api.py -q`.
6. **Backend full suite:** `cd backend && uv run pytest -q`.
7. **Regression:** manually verify:
   - Deleting a user opens a `ConfirmDialog` that shows the user's email and requires typing the email.
   - The users list under a filter with zero matches shows `FilteredEmpty` with a working **Clear filters** button.
   - A recoverable error banner on a list page shows **Retry** and **Reference: <id>**.
   - A toast shown mid-hover does not disappear until pointer leaves and 4 s elapse.
   - `/forbidden` and an unknown URL render `AccessDenied` / `NotFound` using the new components, in both `en` and `ar` locales (toggle via `LanguageSwitcher`).
